source.note: Curated from CASTLE1.EXE story resources (RT 0x104, ids 1-15, see story.json) and the CASTLE1.HLP manual. Original trigger specifics (exact cutscene map positions, boss guard count) were not recoverable from the binary; see gaps.

stages.journalText: Avenge your godparents. The marauders who burned the farm took your father's amulet north, towards the mountains.
At the bottom of the mine you found a scorched parchment signed with a flaming 'S'. It speaks of a fortress north of Bjarnarhaven.
The hamlet lies in ashes. Whoever ordered this sees YOU as the danger. Bjarnarhaven — and the fortress beyond — await.
The fortress north of Bjarnarhaven crawls with Hrungnir's patrols. A crude note names him — and the castle he answers to.
Loot from the bandits' chests came from your farm and village. You are on the right track.
Hrungnir himself awaits on the deepest level of the fortress, with his ogre guards. End this.
Hrungnir wards your spells aside and gloats. Steel will have to finish this.
Vengeance is yours. Hrungnir is dead — and the amulet he stole now hangs around your neck, warm with your father's voice.

gaps.reason: Original cutscenes fire at fixed map positions/states (e.g. the homecoming scene on the trail between mine and hamlet). The port triggers them on level arrivals instead; the single-town approximation has no separate hamlet/Bjarnarhaven maps.
Story text id8 says 'a squad of armored ogres'; exact count unknown from the binary. Ported as 2 Huge Ogres.
The recovered amulet (story ids 11-14) is not in the extracted item catalog; the port grants it as a story flag, not an inventory object.
